citation: Perry E. Borchers (Ohio State University) for HABS, 'NE - angled view', copy photograph of photogrammetric plate LC-HABS-GS05-T-3224-205L, John J. Glessner House, 1800 South Prairie Avenue, Chicago, 1965. HABS IL-1015 photograph 17 of 17 (call number HABS ILL,16-CHIG,17--17). Library of Congress.
author: Perry E. Borchers (HABS)
repository: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division (HABS). Master TIFF 060919pu.tif in the owner's Internet Archive item master-pnp-habshaer-il-il0100-il0118-photos (checksummed in chicago/prairie_1904_v1/research/acquired-files.json); 1800 px web copy committed at chicago/prairie_1904_v1/research/public/glessner-habs-photo-17.jpg (Prairie library, PR #169); the index to photographs (glessner-habs-photo-captions.pdf, same folder) gives the caption and plate number.
locator: The whole plate: the NE corner from across the intersection, both street fronts in perspective.
rights_note: Made for HABS (U.S. Government); LOC: no known restrictions. Measurements only; nothing derived as an asset.
access_notes: Viewed 2026-09-29 (T-1730, version v2) for the order of the stacks and the tower seen from the NE. The caption and plate number are the HABS index to photographs; the handle follows photograph 13's record (060915p), the plates being consecutive in the master TIFF series.
note: A 1965 photogrammetric plate of the series sheet 6 was plotted from (photographs 13-17 are the Borchers plates; the index says 1-12 were transmitted earlier). Used only for masonry and roofs, which the 1946 alteration list (HABS data p. 2) does not touch.
what_it_supplies: the stacks' order from the NE: south and middle stacks on the Prairie slope, the gable stack, the great stack left of (south of) the tower
